quizItems.scenario: The room is clear of visible fire but has moderate smoke and reduced visibility.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Complete a hands-on primary search before moving to the next room.
Do a quick visual scan from the doorway, then move on.
Glance in briefly and mark it cleared.
Skip the room entirely based on the doorway view.

quizItems.rationale: Reduced visibility still needs a hands-on primary search; skipping a room from a doorway glance is the worst option.

quizItems.scenario: You find the gas meter here with the shutoff valve partially obstructed by stored boxes.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Clear access and shut off the gas supply.
Shut off the gas without fully clearing access, if reachable.
Report the obstruction and move on without acting.
Leave it for another crew without flagging it.

quizItems.rationale: An obstructed utility shutoff delays a critical life-safety action for the whole unit; leaving it unflagged is worst.

quizItems.scenario: High-piled storage racks are visible, and smoke is lightly banking near the ceiling, far from any visible fire.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Treat high-piled storage as a collapse/hidden-fire hazard and avoid working underneath.
Work near the racks cautiously, watching the ceiling.
Work directly underneath the racks since no fire is visible.
Assume the area is safe since there is no visible fire anywhere.

quizItems.rationale: High-piled storage can hide fire spread and risks rack collapse; assuming safety from a lack of visible fire is the worst read.

quizItems.scenario: The bathroom is empty but the shower is running and the mirror is fogged.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Shut off the water and widen the search to nearby rooms.
Shut off the water and mark the room cleared.
Leave the water running and move on.
Mark the whole unit cleared since this room is empty.

quizItems.rationale: A running, fogged shower means someone was here minutes ago -- widen the search rather than treating the unit as clear.
